oisd.title: Gas Blowout at Onshore Workover Rig

as_happened.headline: BLOWOUT — Uncontrolled Gas Flow
as_happened.detail: Lighter fluid (1.02 SG) underbalanced the gas zone; kick escalated to 338.9 bbl before the well could be sealed.

with_fixes.headline: SAFE — Perforated with +250 psi Overbalance (No Kick)
with_fixes.detail: Completion fluid (SG 1.15, Ph 3600 psi) balanced the 3350 psi gas formation. Zero influx occurred during or after perforation.

as_happened.headline: UNCONTROLLED RELEASE — ~930 kg Gas & Water at Casing Cut
as_happened.detail: Faulty logging calibration masked the weak outer barrier and the unmaintained ΔP gauge froze, causing trapped annular gas to escape when the 13 3/8-in casing was cut at T+150 min.

with_fixes.headline: SAFE — Outer Barrier Hazard Caught at T+45 min
with_fixes.detail: Hazard recognised at T+45 min; casing cut postponed to T+150 min while annular pressure was safely bled to 0 psi.

oil_idbh.title: Intermediate Tank Farm Indirect Bath Heater Fire

as_happened.headline: FIRE — Hydrocarbon Vapour Ignited During Hot Work
as_happened.detail: With the pressure transmitter frozen at 0.0 psi, a passing valve built up 35.0 psi and 25.1% LEL by Hour 48.0, igniting at maintenance.

with_fixes.headline: SAFE — Maintenance Completed Without Ignition
with_fixes.detail: Hydrocarbon LEL at work start was 0.0% (or stopped at 0.0% after purge/DBB). Safeguard triggered at: Prevented (DBB).
